carry_over.evidence: git: HEAD e4aac4c == origin/main; working tree clean apart from one untracked critic JSON. Live fetch from https://patanakiat.github.io/data-detective/: index.html, app.js, model.js, data.js, styles.css all text-identical to the repo (line-ending-normalised compare); live index.html contains 'about 25%' and not 'about 22%'; live data.js contains Math.exp(5.0 (log-linear weeks); model.js contains pctLateAtDoor. docs/screenshots/*.png byte-identical (SHA-256) to the matching .critic/round-3 captures — checked shot-start-mobile, shot-a1-framing-desktop, shot-a1-framing-mobile, shot-a2-sampling-desktop, shot-a3-correlation-tablet, shot-summary-mobile. npm test: 16 pass / 0 fail; live model values reproduce every figure TEST_REPORT quotes (conv500 56.4 % / 6.89 h, random500 25.4 % / 7.32 h, pop 7.30 h / 25.2 %, r 0.81, within-season 0.26/0.10/0.31, gap 1.8 %→45 %). The drift-guard half of the requested fix (scripts/verify-deploy.mjs + npm script) was not applied — see non_blocking.

non_blocking.issue: The drift guard requested in R2-SC-1 was never added, so the deploy can silently drift from the archive again.
non_blocking.fix: Add scripts/verify-deploy.mjs exactly as specified in the round-2 fix and the script entry "verify-deploy": "node scripts/verify-deploy.mjs" to package.json.

non_blocking.issue: Interaction evidence (gate messages, focus moves, reset, reload) is asserted from ad-hoc Playwright runs that are not in the repository, so a judge cannot reproduce it.
non_blocking.fix: Commit the Playwright walkthrough as tests/interaction.mjs behind an optional `npm run test:ui` that prints a clear skip message when Playwright is absent, and cite it in §2 so the claims are reproducible rather than merely reported.

non_blocking.issue: Educator guide overstates how narrow the convenience-sample range is ('roughly 55–68%'): with a 57 %-late pool a draw of n = 10 scatters far wider than that band.
non_blocking.fix: Replace 'convenience draws run roughly 55–68% late-library users against a true 25% (the sampler design gives 57%)' with 'convenience draws sit far above the true 25% at every size — about 57% in expectation, scattering widely at n = 10 and settling near 57% by n = 500'.

non_blocking.issue: The two Activity-1 series are distinguished by colour alone (rust/teal); a colour-blind sighted learner cannot tell which line is Group A without the visually hidden description.
non_blocking.fix: Add a non-colour channel to the series line and say so in the legend: `.chart polyline.series-b { stroke-dasharray: 10 6; }` plus 'dashed = Group B' in the legend text.

non_blocking.issue: Footer links point at raw markdown files, so a teacher tapping 'Educator guide' on Pages lands in plain text rather than a readable page.
non_blocking.fix: Generate a local guide.html (rendered once from EDUCATOR_GUIDE.md at authoring time) and point the footer link at it; keep it local so no outbound link is added.

keep: Seeded generator with published seeds (20260914 / 3141), a design-intent data dictionary and an export script — reproducible synthetic data at a level most published teaching datasets never reach.
Experiment gates: every check refuses to grade until the experiment has been run ('Run the experiment first.', 'Draw first, then decide.', 'Look inside the seasons first.') — app.js:180, 275, 333.
Misconception-naming wrong-answer branches ('The other way round.', 'Too strict.' / 'Too relaxed.', 'That reads cause into a correlation.') instead of generic right/wrong.
Evidence integrity now holds: docs/screenshots are byte-identical to the round-3 captures and the live Pages files text-match the archive (verified this round).

Authored control layer: min-height 44 px on every interactive control, two-colour :focus-visible rings, aria-live feedback regions, per-chart data tables, and a prefers-reduced-motion kill-switch — styles.css:51-52, 87, 111, 188; index.html:88, 164, 210.
gap_to_10: Seeing Theory (Brown University): there the visual itself is the argument — bespoke, explorable illustration where each manipulation is a designed lesson beat and the craft is inseparable from the statistics. Here the charts are plain SVG inside a document wrapper: the data table is a fallback rather than a second view, and no single interaction is delightful in itself.
